sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining — when any link in the chain is nil, the entire expression silently evaluates to nil without error
sketches.resonance: One missing person in a lineage of care causes every subsequent gesture to resolve to nothing.
sketches.draft:
let kindness: Person? = nil
let received = kindness?.mother?.mother?.gift()

sketches.mechanism: Deferred function calls execute in LIFO order when the surrounding function returns — the last thing deferred runs first
sketches.resonance: What we postpone longest is what finally meets us at the door.

sketches.mechanism: method_missing — when an object receives a message it doesn't understand, it can still respond
sketches.resonance: Even what we have no answer for, we hold; the attempt to respond is itself a kind of presence.
sketches.draft:
class Listener
  def method_missing(whatever, *_)
    self
  end
end

Listener.new.are.you.still.there
